verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred two-line headline with the LIMITED badge and CTA pill grouped below it, so the design stays faithful. Its flaws: the badge+CTA group sits slightly left of the headline's axis, and everything is pushed high, leaving a heavy empty band at the bottom. B has an alignment conflict: the headline is centred but the badge and CTA are left-aligned. The headline is shrunk to a single line, while the LIMITED badge is inflated to nearly the CTA's size, so it competes with the button. That leaves a large dead area on the right and looks unintentional.
